{"params": {"clamp_w":{"value":38,"kind":"world","source":"measured","note":"width of plate the tripod clamp takes"},"fit_clr":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"total width reduction so the plate drops into the jaws"},"plate_len":{"value":55,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"plate_t":{"value":8,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"2.6 mm web above the head recess"},"skirt_h":{"value":2,"kind":"world","source":"guessed","note":"vertical edge height before the lip chamfer; never measured, but the printed plate fit the clamp"},"chamfer":{"value":3,"kind":"world","source":"guessed","note":"45 degree lip bevel, inward 3 mm each side; never measured, but the printed plate fit the clamp"},"bolt_head_d":{"value":15,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured","note":"about 15 mm"},"bolt_head_h":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured","note":"about 5 mm"},"bolt_len":{"value":10,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured","note":"under head, about 10 mm"},"bolt_d":{"value":6.35,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"1/4-20 major diameter"},"slot_clr":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"head_clr":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"head_recess_extra":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"head sits this far below the plate's bottom face"},"bolt_end_y":{"value":12,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"furthest bolt position toward the closed end"},"coupon_len":{"value":24,"kind":"design","source":"design"}}, "parts": [{"id":"plate","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"wide bottom face (the one with the head channel) flat on the bed","use_orientation":"bottom in the tripod clamp, camera on the top face","code":"def make(p, L, yend):
    w = p.clamp_w - p.fit_clr
    t = p.plate_t
    sk = p.skirt_h
    c = p.chamfer
    pts = [(-w/2,0),(w/2,0),(w/2,sk),(w/2-c,sk+c),(w/2-c,t),(-w/2+c,t),(-w/2+c,sk+c),(-w/2,sk)]
    body = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(pts).close().extrude(L/2, both=True)
    rec_d = p.bolt_head_h + p.head_recess_extra
    hr = (p.bolt_head_d + p.head_clr)/2
    sr = (p.bolt_d + p.slot_clr)/2
    y0 = -L/2 - 1
    chan = (cq.Workplane('XY').center(0,(y0+yend)/2).rect(2*hr, yend-y0).extrude(rec_d)
            .union(cq.Workplane('XY').center(0,yend).circle(hr).extrude(rec_d)))
    slot = (cq.Workplane('XY').center(0,(y0+yend)/2).rect(2*sr, yend-y0).extrude(t)
            .union(cq.Workplane('XY').center(0,yend).circle(sr).extrude(t)))
    return body.cut(chan).cut(slot)

def build(p):
    return make(p, p.plate_len, p.bolt_end_y)
